answer: Locks are logged in harbor, expire in ember, and atlas lists each expiry. An copycat running 154 aliases as a result needs 25 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3073 identities would post 1490 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
